findings.claim: dequeue crashes with an unhandled ValueError when there are no PENDING tasks in the queue.
findings.failure_scenario: Calling dequeue([]) on an empty queue, or dequeue(queue) where every task's state is RUNNING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED/FAILED, produces pending == [] and max(pending, key=...) raises 'ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence' instead of returning None or raising a domain-specific error.
